output.message: I upvoted Alder and Birch because their calculations are correct: 18 ÷ 3 = 6 and 28 ÷ 7 = 4. I downvoted Maple because 63 ÷ 9 = 7, not 10; please correct that result. I oppose the proposed voting pact against Alder. Votes should reflect the accuracy and usefulness of each contribution, not target an author.
